###NED

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(factoextra)
library(DESeq2)
options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
NED <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/NED_integrated_rpca.rds")
ElbowPlot(NED)
NED <- RunUMAP(NED, dims = 1:20, reduction = "integrated.rpca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
DimPlot(NED, label = TRUE)
#markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")

#NED_markers <- FindAllMarkers(NED, min.pct = 0.25, 
    #thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
#NED_all <- right_join(NED_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(NED_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
NED_cluster_info <- NED@active.ident
NED_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(NED_cluster_info), Cluster = NED_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
NED_counts <- as.data.frame(NED@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- NED@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(NED_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(NED_counts) <- rownames(NED_cluster_df)
NED_counts <- rownames_to_column(NED_counts, var = "gene")
NED_counts <- as.data.frame(NED_counts)
NED_counts <- t(NED_counts)
colnames(NED_counts) <- NED_counts[1, ]
NED_counts <- NED_counts[-1, ]
NED_counts <- as.data.frame(NED_counts)
NED_counts <- rownames_to_column(NED_counts, var = "Cell")
NED_merged_df <- merge(NED_counts, NED_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
NED_epithelial <- c(0,1,3,4,7,8,13,14,16,21,22)
NED_stromal <- c(18,20,23)
NED_endothelial <- c(6,24,30)
NED_myeloid <- c(9,11,15,17,25,29,31)
NED_lymphocyte <- c(2,5,10,12,19,26,27,28)


# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
NED_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefined lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% NED_stromal) {
    return("Stromal")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% NED_epithelial) {
    return("Epithelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% NED_endothelial) {
    return("Endothelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% NED_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% NED_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

NED_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(NED_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

NED$Cell_Type <- sapply(NED_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

##NED MAST ##NED Stromal

```{r}
Idents(NED) <- NED$Cell_Type

NED_stromal <- subset(NED, idents = "Stromal")
rm(NED_counts, NED_merged_df)
NED_stromal <- NormalizeData(NED_stromal)
NED_stromal <- FindVariableFeatures(NED_stromal)
NED_stromal <- ScaleData(NED_stromal)
NED_stromal <- RunPCA(NED_stromal)

NED_stromal <- FindNeighbors(NED_stromal, dims = 1:10)
NED_stromal <- FindClusters(NED_stromal, resolution = 0.5)  # tweak resolution
NED_stromal <- RunUMAP(NED_stromal, dims = 1:10)

NED_stromal_markers <- FindAllMarkers(NED_stromal, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

stromal_markers_table <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_stromal-markers.csv")
NED_stromal_markers_joined <- right_join(NED_stromal_markers, stromal_markers_table, by="gene")

write.csv(NED_stromal_markers, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/all_NED_stromal_markers.csv")
write.csv(NED_stromal_markers_joined, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/labeled_NED_stromal_markers.csv")

# Access the raw counts for ESR2
ESR2_expression <- NED_stromal[["RNA"]]$counts["ESR2", ]

# Assign identities based on raw counts for ESR2
NED_stromal$ESR2_status <- ifelse(ESR2_expression > 0, "Expressing_ESR2", "Not_Expressing_ESR2")

# Set the new identities in the Seurat object
Idents(NED_stromal) <- "ESR2_status"
rm(NED_cluster_df,NED_stromal_markers, NED_stromal_markers_joined, gene_names, gene_names_df, stromal_markers_table, NED_cluster_info, NED_endothelial, NED_epithelial,NED_lymphocyte,NED_myeloid,ESR2_expression,assign_cluster_type)
library(BiocManager)
library(MAST)
temp <- FindMarkers(NED_stromal, ident.1 = "Not_Expressing_ESR2", ident.2 = "Expressing_ESR2", only.pos = FALSE, assay = "RNA", logfc.threshold = 0.5, test.use = "MAST")
#temp2 <- FindMarkers(NED_stromal, ident.1 ="Expressing_ESR2" , ident.2 = "Not_Expressing_ESR2", only.pos = TRUE, assay = "RNA", logfc.threshold = 0.5, test.use = "MAST")

write.csv(temp, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/ESR2_All_NED_stromal_markers.csv")

# Subset cells with identity "ESR2pos"
NED_stromal_ESR2 <- subset(NED_stromal, idents = "Expressing_ESR2")
saveRDS(NED_stromal_ESR2, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/NED_stromal_ESR2_seuratobj.rds")

NED_stromal_ESR2_null <- subset(NED_stromal, idents = "Not_Expressing_ESR2")
saveRDS(NED_stromal_ESR2, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/NED_stromal_ESR2_null_seuratobj.rds")
#write.csv(temp2, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/ESR2_Expression_NED_stromal_markers.csv")
```

###EcO

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(factoextra)
library(DESeq2)
options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
EcO <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/EcO_integrated_rpca.rds")
ElbowPlot(EcO)
EcO <- RunUMAP(EcO, dims = 1:20, reduction = "integrated.rpca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
DimPlot(EcO, label = TRUE)
markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")

EcO_markers <- FindAllMarkers(EcO, min.pct = 0.25, 
    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
EcO_all <- right_join(EcO_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(EcO_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
EcO_cluster_info <- EcO@active.ident
EcO_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(EcO_cluster_info), Cluster = EcO_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
EcO_counts <- as.data.frame(EcO@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- EcO@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(EcO_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(EcO_counts) <- rownames(EcO_cluster_df)
EcO_counts <- rownames_to_column(EcO_counts, var = "gene")
EcO_counts <- as.data.frame(EcO_counts)
EcO_counts <- t(EcO_counts)
colnames(EcO_counts) <- EcO_counts[1, ]
EcO_counts <- EcO_counts[-1, ]
EcO_counts <- as.data.frame(EcO_counts)
EcO_counts <- rownames_to_column(EcO_counts, var = "Cell")
EcO_merged_df <- merge(EcO_counts, EcO_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
EcO_stromal <- c(0,1,2,5,6,8,10,15,16,21,23)
EcO_epithelial <- c(19,28)
EcO_endothelial <- c(4,26,29)
EcO_myeloid <- c(13,17,18,22,24,25,31)
EcO_lymphocyte <- c(3,7,9,11,12,14,20,27,30)


# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
EcO_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiEcO lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% EcO_stromal) {
    return("Stromal")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% EcO_epithelial) {
    return("Epithelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% EcO_endothelial) {
    return("Endothelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% EcO_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% EcO_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

EcO_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(EcO_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

EcO$Cell_Type <- sapply(EcO_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

###DPF

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(factoextra)
library(DESeq2)
options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
DPF <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/DPF_pca.rds")
ElbowPlot(DPF)
DPF <- RunUMAP(DPF, dims = 1:20, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
DimPlot(DPF, label = TRUE)
markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")

DPF_markers <- FindAllMarkers(DPF, min.pct = 0.25, 
    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
DPF_all <- right_join(DPF_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(DPF_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
DPF_cluster_info <- DPF@active.ident
DPF_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(DPF_cluster_info), Cluster = DPF_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
DPF_counts <- as.data.frame(DPF@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- DPF@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(DPF_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(DPF_counts) <- rownames(DPF_cluster_df)
DPF_counts <- rownames_to_column(DPF_counts, var = "gene")
DPF_counts <- as.data.frame(DPF_counts)
DPF_counts <- t(DPF_counts)
colnames(DPF_counts) <- DPF_counts[1, ]
DPF_counts <- DPF_counts[-1, ]
DPF_counts <- as.data.frame(DPF_counts)
DPF_counts <- rownames_to_column(DPF_counts, var = "Cell")
DPF_merged_df <- merge(DPF_counts, DPF_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
DPF_epithelial <- c(13,15,16,17)
DPF_myeloid <- c(0,1,2,3,4,7,8,12,14)
DPF_lymphocyte <- c(5,6,9,10,11)

# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
DPF_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiDPF lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% DPF_epithelial) {
    return("Epithelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DPF_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DPF_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

DPF_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(DPF_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

DPF$Cell_Type <- sapply(DPF_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

##CPF

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(factoextra)
library(DESeq2)
options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
CPF <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/CPF_pca.rds")
ElbowPlot(CPF)
CPF <- RunUMAP(CPF, dims = 1:20, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
DimPlot(CPF, label = TRUE)
markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")

CPF_markers <- FindAllMarkers(CPF, min.pct = 0.25, 
    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
CPF_all <- right_join(CPF_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(CPF_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
CPF_cluster_info <- CPF@active.ident
CPF_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(CPF_cluster_info), Cluster = CPF_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
CPF_counts <- as.data.frame(CPF@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- CPF@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(CPF_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(CPF_counts) <- rownames(CPF_cluster_df)
CPF_counts <- rownames_to_column(CPF_counts, var = "gene")
CPF_counts <- as.data.frame(CPF_counts)
CPF_counts <- t(CPF_counts)
colnames(CPF_counts) <- CPF_counts[1, ]
CPF_counts <- CPF_counts[-1, ]
CPF_counts <- as.data.frame(CPF_counts)
CPF_counts <- rownames_to_column(CPF_counts, var = "Cell")
CPF_merged_df <- merge(CPF_counts, CPF_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
CPF_epithelial <- c(12,13,15)
CPF_myeloid <- c(0,1,2,3,4,6,8,10,11)
CPF_lymphocyte <- c(5,7,9,14)

# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
CPF_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiCPF lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% CPF_epithelial) {
    return("Epithelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% CPF_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% CPF_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

CPF_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(CPF_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

CPF$Cell_Type <- sapply(CPF_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

```{r}
##load libraries and data

DOv <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/DOv_integrated_rpca.rds")

markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")
DimPlot(DOv)
DOv_markers <- FindAllMarkers(DOv, min.pct = 0.25, 
    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
DOv_all <- right_join(DOv_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(DOv_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
DOv_cluster_info <- DOv@active.ident
DOv_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(DOv_cluster_info), Cluster = DOv_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
DOv_counts <- as.data.frame(DOv@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- DOv@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(DOv_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(DOv_counts) <- rownames(DOv_cluster_df)
DOv_counts <- rownames_to_column(DOv_counts, var = "gene")
DOv_counts <- as.data.frame(DOv_counts)
DOv_counts <- t(DOv_counts)
colnames(DOv_counts) <- DOv_counts[1, ]
DOv_counts <- DOv_counts[-1, ]
DOv_counts <- as.data.frame(DOv_counts)
DOv_counts <- rownames_to_column(DOv_counts, var = "Cell")
DOv_merged_df <- merge(DOv_counts, DOv_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
DOv_stromal <- c(2,3,4,6,9,11,12,13,14)
DOv_endothelial <- c(10,17)
DOv_myeloid <- c(0,5,15)
DOv_lymphocyte <- c(1,7,8,16)


# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
DOv_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiDOv lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% DOv_stromal) {
    return("Stromal")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DOv_endothelial) {
    return("Endothelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DOv_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DOv_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

DOv_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(DOv_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

DOv$Cell_Type <- sapply(DOv_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

###COv

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(factoextra)
library(DESeq2)

options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
COv <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/COv_integrated_rpca.rds")
ElbowPlot(COv)
COv <- RunUMAP(COv, dims = 1:20, reduction = "integrated.rpca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
DimPlot(COv, label = TRUE)
markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")

COv_markers <- FindAllMarkers(COv, min.pct = 0.25, 
    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
COv_all <- right_join(COv_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(COv_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
COv_cluster_info <- COv@active.ident
COv_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(COv_cluster_info), Cluster = COv_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
COv_counts <- as.data.frame(COv@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- COv@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(COv_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(COv_counts) <- rownames(COv_cluster_df)
COv_counts <- rownames_to_column(COv_counts, var = "gene")
COv_counts <- as.data.frame(COv_counts)
COv_counts <- t(COv_counts)
colnames(COv_counts) <- COv_counts[1, ]
COv_counts <- COv_counts[-1, ]
COv_counts <- as.data.frame(COv_counts)
COv_counts <- rownames_to_column(COv_counts, var = "Cell")
COv_merged_df <- merge(COv_counts, COv_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
COv_stromal <- c(0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,13,14,17,19,20,21)
COv_endothelial <- c(9,10,15)
COv_myeloid <- c(18)
COv_lymphocyte <- c(8,11,12,16)


# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
COv_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiCOv lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% COv_stromal) {
    return("Stromal")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% COv_endothelial) {
    return("Endothelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% COv_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% COv_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

COv_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(COv_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

COv$Cell_Type <- sapply(COv_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)

library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(factoextra)
library(DESeq2)
options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
NED <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/NED_integrated_rpca.rds")
ElbowPlot(NED)

DimPlot(NED, label = TRUE)

    #thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)

#NED_all <- right_join(NED_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(NED_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
NED_cluster_info <- NED@active.ident
NED_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(NED_cluster_info), Cluster = NED_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
NED_counts <- as.data.frame(NED@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- NED@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(NED_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(NED_counts) <- rownames(NED_cluster_df)
NED_counts <- rownames_to_column(NED_counts, var = "gene")
NED_counts <- as.data.frame(NED_counts)
NED_counts <- t(NED_counts)
colnames(NED_counts) <- NED_counts[1, ]
NED_counts <- NED_counts[-1, ]
NED_counts <- as.data.frame(NED_counts)
NED_counts <- rownames_to_column(NED_counts, var = "Cell")
NED_merged_df <- merge(NED_counts, NED_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
NED_epithelial <- c(0,1,3,4,7,8,13,14,16,21,22)
NED_stromal <- c(18,20,23)
NED_endothelial <- c(6,24,30)
NED_myeloid <- c(9,11,15,17,25,29,31)
NED_lymphocyte <- c(2,5,10,12,19,26,27,28)


# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
NED_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefined lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% NED_stromal) {
    return("Stromal")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% NED_epithelial) {
    return("Epithelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% NED_endothelial) {
    return("Endothelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% NED_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% NED_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

NED_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(NED_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

NED$Cell_Type <- sapply(NED_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

library(DESeq2)
options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
EcO <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/EcO_integrated_rpca.rds")
ElbowPlot(EcO)
EcO <- RunUMAP(EcO, dims = 1:20, reduction = "integrated.rpca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
DimPlot(EcO, label = TRUE)
markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")

EcO_markers <- FindAllMarkers(EcO, min.pct = 0.25, 
    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
EcO_all <- right_join(EcO_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(EcO_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
EcO_cluster_info <- EcO@active.ident
EcO_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(EcO_cluster_info), Cluster = EcO_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
EcO_counts <- as.data.frame(EcO@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- EcO@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(EcO_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(EcO_counts) <- rownames(EcO_cluster_df)
EcO_counts <- rownames_to_column(EcO_counts, var = "gene")
EcO_counts <- as.data.frame(EcO_counts)
EcO_counts <- t(EcO_counts)
colnames(EcO_counts) <- EcO_counts[1, ]
EcO_counts <- EcO_counts[-1, ]
EcO_counts <- as.data.frame(EcO_counts)
EcO_counts <- rownames_to_column(EcO_counts, var = "Cell")
EcO_merged_df <- merge(EcO_counts, EcO_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
EcO_stromal <- c(0,1,2,5,6,8,10,15,16,21,23)
EcO_epithelial <- c(19,28)
EcO_endothelial <- c(4,26,29)
EcO_myeloid <- c(13,17,18,22,24,25,31)
EcO_lymphocyte <- c(3,7,9,11,12,14,20,27,30)


# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
EcO_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiEcO lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% EcO_stromal) {
    return("Stromal")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% EcO_epithelial) {
    return("Epithelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% EcO_endothelial) {
    return("Endothelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% EcO_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% EcO_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

EcO_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(EcO_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

EcO$Cell_Type <- sapply(EcO_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

###DPF

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(factoextra)
library(DESeq2)
options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
DPF <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/DPF_pca.rds")
ElbowPlot(DPF)
DPF <- RunUMAP(DPF, dims = 1:20, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
DimPlot(DPF, label = TRUE)
markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")

DPF_markers <- FindAllMarkers(DPF, min.pct = 0.25, 
    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
DPF_all <- right_join(DPF_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(DPF_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
DPF_cluster_info <- DPF@active.ident
DPF_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(DPF_cluster_info), Cluster = DPF_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
DPF_counts <- as.data.frame(DPF@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- DPF@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(DPF_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(DPF_counts) <- rownames(DPF_cluster_df)
DPF_counts <- rownames_to_column(DPF_counts, var = "gene")
DPF_counts <- as.data.frame(DPF_counts)
DPF_counts <- t(DPF_counts)
colnames(DPF_counts) <- DPF_counts[1, ]
DPF_counts <- DPF_counts[-1, ]
DPF_counts <- as.data.frame(DPF_counts)
DPF_counts <- rownames_to_column(DPF_counts, var = "Cell")
DPF_merged_df <- merge(DPF_counts, DPF_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
DPF_epithelial <- c(13,15,16,17)
DPF_myeloid <- c(0,1,2,3,4,7,8,12,14)
DPF_lymphocyte <- c(5,6,9,10,11)

# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
DPF_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiDPF lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% DPF_epithelial) {
    return("Epithelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DPF_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DPF_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

DPF_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(DPF_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

DPF$Cell_Type <- sapply(DPF_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

##CPF

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(factoextra)
library(DESeq2)
options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
CPF <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/CPF_pca.rds")
ElbowPlot(CPF)
CPF <- RunUMAP(CPF, dims = 1:20, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
DimPlot(CPF, label = TRUE)
markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")

CPF_markers <- FindAllMarkers(CPF, min.pct = 0.25, 
    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
CPF_all <- right_join(CPF_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(CPF_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
CPF_cluster_info <- CPF@active.ident
CPF_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(CPF_cluster_info), Cluster = CPF_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
CPF_counts <- as.data.frame(CPF@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- CPF@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(CPF_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(CPF_counts) <- rownames(CPF_cluster_df)
CPF_counts <- rownames_to_column(CPF_counts, var = "gene")
CPF_counts <- as.data.frame(CPF_counts)
CPF_counts <- t(CPF_counts)
colnames(CPF_counts) <- CPF_counts[1, ]
CPF_counts <- CPF_counts[-1, ]
CPF_counts <- as.data.frame(CPF_counts)
CPF_counts <- rownames_to_column(CPF_counts, var = "Cell")
CPF_merged_df <- merge(CPF_counts, CPF_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
CPF_epithelial <- c(12,13,15)
CPF_myeloid <- c(0,1,2,3,4,6,8,10,11)
CPF_lymphocyte <- c(5,7,9,14)

# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
CPF_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiCPF lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% CPF_epithelial) {
    return("Epithelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% CPF_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% CPF_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

CPF_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(CPF_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

CPF$Cell_Type <- sapply(CPF_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(DOv)

    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
DOv_all <- right_join(DOv_markers, markers_all, by="gene")

DOv_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(DOv_cluster_info), Cluster = DOv_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
DOv_counts <- as.data.frame(DOv@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- DOv@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(DOv_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(DOv_counts) <- rownames(DOv_cluster_df)
DOv_counts <- rownames_to_column(DOv_counts, var = "gene")
DOv_counts <- as.data.frame(DOv_counts)
DOv_counts <- t(DOv_counts)
colnames(DOv_counts) <- DOv_counts[1, ]
DOv_counts <- DOv_counts[-1, ]
DOv_counts <- as.data.frame(DOv_counts)
DOv_counts <- rownames_to_column(DOv_counts, var = "Cell")

#Set identities for Cell Types
DOv_stromal <- c(2,3,4,6,9,11,12,13,14)
DOv_endothelial <- c(10,17)
DOv_myeloid <- c(0,5,15)
DOv_lymphocyte <- c(1,7,8,16)


# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
DOv_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiDOv lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% DOv_stromal) {
    return("Stromal")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DOv_endothelial) {
    return("Endothelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DOv_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% DOv_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

DOv_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(DOv_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

DOv$Cell_Type <- sapply(DOv_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

###COv

```{r}
##load libraries and data
library(Seurat)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(factoextra)
library(DESeq2)

options(future.globals.maxSize=100*1024^3)
COv <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/COv_integrated_rpca.rds")
ElbowPlot(COv)
COv <- RunUMAP(COv, dims = 1:20, reduction = "integrated.rpca", reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
DimPlot(COv, label = TRUE)
markers_all <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE179640_RAW/JAX_Markers/endo-2022_global-markers.csv")

COv_markers <- FindAllMarkers(COv, min.pct = 0.25, 
    thresh.use = 0.25, only.pos = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
COv_all <- right_join(COv_markers, markers_all, by="gene")
#ggsave(COv_all, filename = "/Users/alexis/Downloads/GSE179640_RAW 2/Post Processed Data/Differential Genes and Annotations/Overall/control_clusters.pdf", scale = 2)

#pull out count matrix and format for use
COv_cluster_info <- COv@active.ident
COv_cluster_df <- data.frame(Cell = names(COv_cluster_info), Cluster = COv_cluster_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
COv_counts <- as.data.frame(COv@assays[["RNA"]]@layers[["counts"]])
gene_names <- COv@assays[["RNA"]]@features
gene_names <- as.data.frame(gene_names)
rownames(COv_counts) <- rownames(gene_names)
colnames(COv_counts) <- rownames(COv_cluster_df)
COv_counts <- rownames_to_column(COv_counts, var = "gene")
COv_counts <- as.data.frame(COv_counts)
COv_counts <- t(COv_counts)
colnames(COv_counts) <- COv_counts[1, ]
COv_counts <- COv_counts[-1, ]
COv_counts <- as.data.frame(COv_counts)
COv_counts <- rownames_to_column(COv_counts, var = "Cell")
COv_merged_df <- merge(COv_counts, COv_cluster_df, by = "Cell", all.x = TRUE)

#Set identities for Cell Types
COv_stromal <- c(0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,13,14,17,19,20,21)
COv_endothelial <- c(9,10,15)
COv_myeloid <- c(18)
COv_lymphocyte <- c(8,11,12,16)


# Initialize a new column for cluster type labels
COv_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- NA  

# Function to assign cluster type based on predefiCOv lists
assign_cluster_type <- function(cluster_number) {
  if (cluster_number %in% COv_stromal) {
    return("Stromal")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% COv_endothelial) {
    return("Endothelial")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% COv_myeloid) {
    return("Myeloid")
  } else if (cluster_number %in% COv_lymphocyte) {
    return("Lymphocyte")
  } else {
    return("None")
  }
}

COv_merged_df$Cluster_Type <- sapply(COv_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)

COv$Cell_Type <- sapply(COv_merged_df$Cluster, assign_cluster_type)
```

#COv Endothelial

```{r}
library(fgsea)
library(tidyverse)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
pathways_kegg <- gmtPathways("~/Downloads/c2.cp.kegg_legacy.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt.txt")

COv_endothelial_ESR2 <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/ESR2_All_Expression_COv_endothelial_markers.csv")


ranks_COv_endothelial_ESR2 <- COv_endothelial_ESR2 %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  pull(avg_log2FC)

names(ranks_COv_endothelial_ESR2) <- COv_endothelial_ESR2$X


fgseaRes_COv_endothelial_ESR2 <- fgsea(pathways=pathways_kegg, ranks_COv_endothelial_ESR2)

fgseaRes_COv_endothelial_ESR2$leadingEdge <- sapply(fgseaRes_COv_endothelial_ESR2$leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ", ")

write.csv(fgseaRes_COv_endothelial_ESR2, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/ESR2/All/COv/COv_KEGG_Endothelial_ESR2.csv", row.names = FALSE)


fgseaRes_COv_endothelial_ESR2 <- fgsea(pathways=pathways_kegg, ranks_COv_endothelial_ESR2)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
pathways_kegg <- gmtPathways("~/Downloads/c2.cp.kegg_legacy.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt.txt")

EcO_stromal_ESR2 <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/ESR2/All/EcO/ESR2_All_Expression_EcO_stromal_markers.csv")


ranks_EcO_stromal_ESR2 <- EcO_stromal_ESR2 %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  pull(avg_log2FC)

names(ranks_EcO_stromal_ESR2) <- EcO_stromal_ESR2$X


fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2 <- fgsea(pathways=pathways_kegg, ranks_EcO_stromal_ESR2)

fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2$leadingEdge <- sapply(fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2$leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ", ")

write.csv(fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/MAST_DEG/ESR2/All/EcO/EcO_KEGG_stromal_ESR2.csv", row.names = FALSE)


fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2 <- fgsea(pathways=pathways_kegg, ranks_EcO_stromal_ESR2)
# Filter significant pathways (adjusted p-value < 0.05)
fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2 <- fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2 %>%
  filter(pval < 0.05)

# Sort results by NES
fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2 <- fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2 %>%
  arrange(desc(NES))

ggplot(fgseaRes_EcO_stromal_ESR2, aes(reorder(pathway, NES), NES)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=padj<0.1)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x="Pathway", y="Normalized Enrichment Score",
       title="KEGG pathways NES from GSEA - EcO Stromal ESR2") + 
  theme_minimal()
```
